summary: Iteration 39: validated the fixed logout policies and targeted realtime refresh. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass (run with -n 0, because xdist parallelism makes the shared revision counter race between tests). Owner/Admin/Bar Team login response, session doc, cookie, /auth/me and /sync/revision all equal next 00:00 WIB. Rider EOD close sets exactly +4h (not 3h), and re-closing keeps the first closed_at. Rider login after the deadline returns 403 'Sesi Rider hari ini telah berakhir setelah batas empat jam EOD.' with no cookie. app_revision lives in Mongo counters, survives a backend restart (16 -> 16), increments +1 per successful mutation, and does NOT increment for /gps, /notifications/read, /auth/* or failed mutations. Frontend: FOUND AND FIXED 1 CRITICAL bug: every Rider was logged out instantly on load before EOD, because the 30-day session overflowed setTimeout. After the fix, all realtime and state-preservation flows pass. Cross-context central stock change: Dashboard updated in 2.2s and MenuStock in 3.8s, while MenuStock's open Edit Menu dialog kept the unsaved typed name. Invoice: an external stock change refetched /menus once while qty, customer, phone and note were kept. The invoice result modal stayed open after another external mutation. POS (Rider, mobile): another user's sale updated remaining stock (10 -> 9) while the cart (2x, Rp 16.000) and customer name were kept. The sale receipt modal stayed open after 2 external mutations. Rider UI auto-logout fired exactly at the session_ends_at (EOD+4h) deadline. DB was reset with reset_final_revision.py and the baseline verified.

minor.issue: A Rider session before EOD is now+30 days. If EOD is never closed, the session stays valid for up to 30 days. A Rider who logs in after WIB midnight (new date, no EOD yet) also gets a fresh 30-day session even when the previous day's EOD+4h window is still running. Confirm this is the intended policy.
Pre-existing: 'Storage init failed: 401 Unauthorized' from objstore/storage/init on every restart. Photo uploads may be affected.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY T1. window.setTimeout(logout, session_ends_at - now) was used with a Rider pre-EOD session_ends_at about 30 days ahead. Delays above 2^31-1 ms (about 24.8 days) overflow, so the timer fired immediately. Every Rider was logged out right after login (seen in network: /auth/me 200, then /auth/logout). Fix: clamp the delay to 2147483647 and only call logout if Date.now() >= sessionEnd.

integration_issues.issue: In lib/api.js the interceptor dispatches si4am:data-changed for EVERY non-auth POST/PUT/DELETE, including /gps and /notifications/read. So the Rider's own GPS pings and notification reads still trigger a local refetch on Dashboard/MenuStock/Invoice/POS, even though the server correctly ignores them. Also, every local mutation refetches twice: once from the local event and again when the next 6s poll sees the new server revision.

rca of the issue: Rider instant logout: session_expiry_for returns now+30d for a Rider without an EOD today. AuthContext set setTimeout(logout, ~2.59e9 ms). Browsers store the delay as a signed 32-bit int, so values above 2147483647 overflow and fire about immediately. Reproduction: create a rider, log in, open any page; you are back on the login page within about 1s. Mitigation (applied): clamp the delay and re-check Date.now() >= sessionEnd before logging out. Verified the Rider stays logged in, and the UI still logs out exactly at a near deadline (EOD+4h test: logout fired at 12:54:32 for a session_ends_at of 12:54:31.98).
